source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Calculate the value-based joint-creditor consent threshold

payload.title: Use the record-date value, not votes per institution
payload.core_explanation_md:
The section 13(9) condition uses not less than sixty per cent in value of the specified amount outstanding on the record date, subject to the IBC qualification. The definition includes the described principal, interest and other dues in the relevant creditor books. A lender headcount majority can fail the value test.

Use a reconciled common record date and denominator. Divide the approving creditors qualifying outstanding amount by the total qualifying outstanding amount. Do not round a below-threshold exact value upward to claim approval. Meeting this calculation alone does not establish every other enforcement condition or defeat an applicable insolvency restriction.

self_check.prompt_text: Can three small creditors automatically outvote a larger outstanding-value share?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory condition is value-based.

payload.title: Compute the qualifying approval share
payload.core_explanation_md: Stipulate qualifying outstanding amounts of INR 2,400,000, INR 3,600,000 and INR 4,000,000 on the same record date. The first two creditors approve.
payload.final_answer_with_unit: Approval share60.00%; the stated value threshold alone is met

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: On the agreed record date, total qualifying outstanding value is INR 12,000,000. Approving creditors represent INR 6,900,000. Calculate their value share as a percentage, to2decimal places HALF_UP. Enter the percentage number.
payload.correct_explanation_md: 6,900,000/12,000,000×100=57.50%. This is below60%; headcount does not cure that.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Retain exact intermediate amounts and round only the final answer HALF_UP to the stated decimal places.

payload.stem_md: A calculated exact approving share is below60 per cent, but the lender rounds it to a whole number of60 and declares the statutory threshold met. What is wrong?

options.text_md: Display rounding must not turn a below-threshold exact share into compliance
options.explanation_md: Apply the threshold to the exact qualifying ratio.

options.text_md: Any positive share meets the test

options.explanation_md: The denominator is tied to that date.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Apply the threshold to the exact qualifying ratio.

payload.title: Consortium consent check
payload.scenario_narrative_md: The consortium has an agreed record date and reconciled qualifying amounts. For this exercise, calculate only the approval share and test the stated60 per cent value requirement. No conclusion about other enforcement or insolvency conditions is requested.
